text:
- [IARC.7.6] Standard C library and `libm`. The platform libraries a
  row links are that row's, and its tarball names them ([NGST.3.1]). A
  thread library among them, such as `-lpthread`, is a transitive
  libc/toolchain need, **not** a thread dependency: libds makes no
  `pthread_*` calls and starts no threads, consistent with [IARC.1.10] —
  link-time presence ≠ call-time use.
